Evidence: `test_plan_004_f002_replay_volley_reaches_clean_terminal` uses fabricated `plan_004_f002_like_commands` and only calls `_apply_target_accountability`; the actual Plan 004 F002 implementer commands from `2026-05-09-004.../claude-implementer-F002-i0.json` replay as `signed_off 0 []`. Recommendation: load the real reproducer input and assert the post-iter/dispatch path reaches one of the accepted terminal states.

FINDING (low, correctness): Parse advisory text is double-prefixed. Evidence: `supervisor.py:2493` builds `shlex parse failed: {guard.parse_error}`, while `guard.parse_error` already includes `shlex parse failed: ...`; the smoke check printed `shlex parse failed: shlex parse failed: No closing quotation`. Recommendation: store the raw `ValueError` message separately or avoid re-prefixing in supervisor.
